name: Endgame
description:
The Endgame MCP Server gives Claude direct access to your organization’s revenue intelligence across CRM records, meeting transcripts, emails, Slack conversations, uploaded documents, and more.

Claude can search your organization’s context graph, look up accounts and people, find stakeholders, explore facts and relationships, and retrieve source-backed context without leaving the conversation. Endgame also lets users create and manage scheduled digests.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Endgame to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Endgame to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.endgame.io/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Endgame MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Endgame lists 27 MCP tools, including create_digest, delete_digest, download_skill_assets, find_graph_person, get_digest, get_graph_citations, get_graph_entities, get_graph_facts, get_graph_field_catalog, get_graph_index, get_graph_person, and get_graph_relationships.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Endgame?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Endgame in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Endgame requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Endgame is developed by Endgame Labs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
